Software

List of the programs and apps that I currently use and thus I can reccommend at least partially for some purposes. They're mostly free.

Programs

  • Image editor: Paint Tool Sai PAID - I bought a lifetime license for version 2 on sale.
  • Web browser: Zen Browser
  • Screen adjuster: f.lux

Code editors

  • general/websites: VSCode
  • Python: PyCharm

Office

  • LibreOffice
  • Notepad++
  • Todoist has many PAID options, but I only use the free parts.

Communication

  • discord
  • Telegram

Web-based

Office

  • Elipsus
  • Canva has many PAID options, but I only use the free parts.
  • Bitwarden Password Manager has many PAID options, but I only use the free parts.
